step_by_step_approach: Select all race records that occurred between 1950 and 1959.
Identify the drivers appearing in those records.
Group the records by driver and by each season within the 1950s.
Retain only those driver‑season groups where the driver took part in at least two different race rounds.
For each remaining driver‑season group, find the earliest race round the driver entered.
For each remaining driver‑season group, find the latest race round the driver entered.
Compare the constructor associated with the earliest race to the constructor of the latest race for each driver‑season group.
Keep the drivers whose earliest and latest races in the season were with the same constructor.
Return the list of distinct drivers that satisfy all conditions.
